summary.text: Kevin Vayko is the Libertarian Party candidate for Michigan's 9th District and an environmental engineer. He also ran in the district's 2024 general election.

paragraphs.text: Born in Michigan and graduated from Almont High School.
Earned a bachelor's degree from Michigan Technological University in 2011 and works as an environmental engineer.
Was the Libertarian candidate in the 2024 general election for this district, which Rep. Lisa McClain won; advanced from the Libertarian convention on June 28, 2026.
